position: real_world_sw_x/y; smoothed EPSG:3857 metres translated per recording
heading: derived
canonical_storage: linearly resampled within continuous source segments to consecutive 2.5 Hz canonical steps
scene_identity: physical square/dataset grouping is scene_id; each source recording is scene_sequence
area_source: Main-table density uses the per-recording occupancy grid; supplied place polygons provide an appendix lower bound. Test_set is quarantined because all nine files are byte-identical duplicates.

heading_provenance.meaning: Direction of travel (course-over-ground), not body/sensor orientation.
heading_provenance.computed_from: atan2 of the position delta between each row's neighboring canonical steps after resampling (convert.py::_headings).
